plain: A person with full citizen rights, not a slave or serf

webster.text: One who enjoys liberty, or who is not subject to the will of another; one not a slave or vassal.

example.quote: That every freeman ought to find a certain remedy by recourse to the laws for all injuries and wrongs he may receive in his person, property or character.
example.cite: Ratification of the Constitution by the State of Virginia, June 26, 1788
